description: A free-thinking individual with an innate curiosity, Craig is a naturally open and adaptable person who values his independence. His impulsiveness often leads him to take calculated risks, making the most of new opportunities without overthinking consequences. Despite this, he remains attentive to those around him, particularly in matters close to his heart. Modesty is not a trait commonly associated with him, but it's one he holds dear when it comes to personal relationships, where he prefers to keep things simple and uncomplicated.
